verses.original: Προσέχετε δὲ τὴν μὴ ποιεῖν ὑμῶν δικαιοσύνην ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ἀνθρώπων πρὸς τὸ θεαθῆναι αὐτοῖς εἰ δὲ μή¦γε ἔχετε οὐκ μισθὸν παρὰ τῷ ὑμῶν Πατρὶ τῷ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς
verses.transliteration: Prosechete de tēn mē poiein hymōn dikaiosynēn emprosthen tōn anthrōpōn pros to theathēnai autois ei de mē¦ge echete ouk misthon para tō hymōn Patri tō en tois ouranois
verses.literal: Be careful - - not to perform your righteous acts before - men vvv vvv to be seen by them If [you do] . . . you will have no reward from - your Father - in - heaven

verses.original: οὖν Ὅταν ποιῇς ἐλεημοσύνην σαλπίσῃς μὴ ἔμπροσθέν σου ὥσπερ οἱ ὑποκριταὶ ποιοῦσιν ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς καὶ ἐν ταῖς ῥύμαις ὅπως δοξασθῶσιν ὑπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ἀπέχουσιν τὸν αὐτῶν μισθὸν
verses.transliteration: oun Hotan poiēs eleēmosynēn salpisēs mē emprosthen sou hōsper hoi hypokritai poiousin en tais synagōgais kai en tais rhymais hopōs doxasthōsin hypo tōn anthrōpōn amēn legō hymin apechousin ton autōn misthon
verses.literal: So when you give to the needy . . . do not sound a trumpet . . . before you as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the streets to be honored by - men Truly I tell you they already have - their full reward

verses.original: δὲ σοῦ ποιοῦντος ἐλεημοσύνην μὴ ἡ σου ἀριστερά γνώτω τί ἡ σου δεξιά ποιεῖ
verses.transliteration: de sou poiountos eleēmosynēn mē hē sou aristera gnōtō ti hē sou dexia poiei
verses.literal: But [when] you give to the needy . . . {do} not {let} - your left [hand] know what - your right hand is doing

verses.original: ὅπως σου ἡ ἐλεημοσύνη ᾖ ἐν τῷ κρυπτῷ καὶ ὁ σου Πατήρ ὁ βλέπων ἐν τῷ κρυπτῷ ἀποδώσει σοι
verses.transliteration: hopōs sou hē eleēmosynē ē en tō kryptō kai ho sou Patēr ho blepōn en tō kryptō apodōsei soi
verses.literal: so that your - giving may be in - secret And - your Father - who sees vvv what is done in secret will reward you

verses.original: Καὶ ὅταν προσεύχησθε ἔσεσθε οὐκ ὡς οἱ ὑποκριταί ὅτι φιλοῦσιν προσεύχεσθαι ἑστῶτες ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς καὶ ἐν ταῖς τῶν πλατειῶν γωνίαις ὅπως φανῶσιν τοῖς ἀνθρώποις ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ἀπέχουσιν τὸν αὐτῶν μισθὸν
verses.transliteration: Kai hotan proseuchēsthe esesthe ouk hōs hoi hypokritai hoti philousin proseuchesthai hestōtes en tais synagōgais kai en tais tōn plateiōn gōniais hopōs phanōsin tois anthrōpois amēn legō hymin apechousin ton autōn misthon
verses.literal: And when you pray do not be . . . like the hypocrites For they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the - street corners vvv to be seen - by men Truly I tell you they already have - their full reward

verses.original: δὲ σὺ ὅταν προσεύχῃ εἴσελθε εἰς τὸ σου ταμεῖόν καὶ κλείσας τὴν σου θύραν πρόσευξαι τῷ σου Πατρί τῷ ἐν τῷ κρυπτῷ καὶ ὁ σου Πατήρ ὁ βλέπων ἐν τῷ κρυπτῷ ἀποδώσει σοι
verses.transliteration: de sy hotan proseuchē eiselthe eis to sou tameion kai kleisas tēn sou thyran proseuxai tō sou Patri tō en tō kryptō kai ho sou Patēr ho blepōn en tō kryptō apodōsei soi
verses.literal: But - when you pray go into - your inner room - shut - your door [and] pray to your Father who [is] vvv vvv unseen And - your Father who sees vvv what is done in secret will reward you

verses.original: δὲ Προσευχόμενοι βατταλογήσητε μὴ ὥσπερ οἱ ἐθνικοί γὰρ δοκοῦσιν ὅτι ἐν τῇ αὐτῶν πολυλογίᾳ εἰσακουσθήσονται
verses.transliteration: de Proseuchomenoi battalogēsēte mē hōsper hoi ethnikoi gar dokousin hoti en tē autōn polylogia eisakousthēsontai
verses.literal: And [when] you pray do not babble on . . . like - pagans for they think that by - their many words they will be heard

verses.original: οὖν μὴ ὁμοιωθῆτε αὐτοῖς γὰρ ὁ ὑμῶν Πατὴρ οἶδεν ὧν ἔχετε χρείαν πρὸ τοῦ ὑμᾶς αἰτῆσαι αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: oun mē homoiōthēte autois gar ho hymōn Patēr oiden hōn echete chreian pro tou hymas aitēsai auton
verses.literal: - [Do] not be like them for vvv your Father knows what you need before - you ask Him

verses.original: οὖν Οὕτως ὑμεῖς προσεύχεσθε ἡμῶν Πάτερ ὁ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς Ἁγιασθήτω τὸ σου ὄνομά
verses.transliteration: oun Houtōs hymeis proseuchesthe hēmōn Pater ho en tois ouranois Hagiasthētō to sou onoma
verses.literal: So then this is how you should pray Our Father - in - heaven hallowed be - Your name

verses.original: ἡ σου βασιλεία Ἐλθέτω τὸ σου θέλημά Γενηθήτω καὶ ἐπὶ γῆς Ὡς ἐν οὐρανῷ
verses.transliteration: hē sou basileia Elthetō to sou thelēma Genēthētō kai epi gēs Hōs en ouranō
verses.literal: - Your kingdom come - Your will be done - on earth as [it is] in heaven

verses.original: δὸς ἡμῖν σήμερον Τὸν ἡμῶν τὸν ἐπιούσιον ἄρτον
verses.transliteration: dos hēmin sēmeron Ton hēmōn ton epiousion arton
verses.literal: Give us this day - our - daily bread

verses.original: Καὶ ἄφες ἡμῖν τὰ ἡμῶν ὀφειλήματα Ὡς ἡμεῖς καὶ ἀφήκαμεν τοῖς ἡμῶν ὀφειλέταις
verses.transliteration: Kai aphes hēmin ta hēmōn opheilēmata Hōs hēmeis kai aphēkamen tois hēmōn opheiletais
verses.literal: And forgive us - our debts as we also have forgiven - our debtors

verses.original: Καὶ εἰσενέγκῃς ἡμᾶς μὴ εἰς πειρασμόν Ἀλλὰ ῥῦσαι ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ τοῦ πονηροῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai eisenenkēs hēmas mē eis peirasmon Alla rhysai hēmas apo tou ponērou
verses.literal: And lead us not into temptation but deliver us from the evil [one]

verses.original: γὰρ Ἐὰν ἀφῆτε τοῖς ἀνθρώποις τὰ αὐτῶν παραπτώματα ὁ ὑμῶν ὁ οὐράνιος Πατὴρ ἀφήσει καὶ ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: gar Ean aphēte tois anthrōpois ta autōn paraptōmata ho hymōn ho ouranios Patēr aphēsei kai hymin
verses.literal: For if you forgive - men - their trespasses - your - heavenly Father will also forgive . . . you

verses.original: δὲ ἐὰν ἀφῆτε μὴ τοῖς ἀνθρώποις τὰ αὐτῶν παραπτώματα οὐδὲ ὁ ὑμῶν Πατὴρ ἀφήσει τὰ ὑμῶν παραπτώματα
verses.transliteration: de ean aphēte mē tois anthrōpois ta autōn paraptōmata oude ho hymōn Patēr aphēsei ta hymōn paraptōmata
verses.literal: But if you do not forgive . . . - men - their trespasses neither {will} your Father forgive - yours . . .

verses.original: δὲ Ὅταν νηστεύητε μὴ γίνεσθε σκυθρωποί ὡς οἱ ὑποκριταὶ γὰρ ἀφανίζουσιν τὰ αὐτῶν πρόσωπα ὅπως φανῶσιν τοῖς ἀνθρώποις νηστεύοντες ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ἀπέχουσιν τὸν αὐτῶν μισθὸν
verses.transliteration: de Hotan nēsteuēte mē ginesthe skythrōpoi hōs hoi hypokritai gar aphanizousin ta autōn prosōpa hopōs phanōsin tois anthrōpois nēsteuontes amēn legō hymin apechousin ton autōn misthon
verses.literal: - When you fast [do] not be somber like the hypocrites for they disfigure - their faces vvv to show - men they are fasting Truly I tell you they already have - their full reward

verses.original: δὲ σὺ νηστεύων ἄλειψαί σου τὴν κεφαλὴν καὶ νίψαι τὸ σου πρόσωπόν
verses.transliteration: de sy nēsteuōn aleipsai sou tēn kephalēn kai nipsai to sou prosōpon
verses.literal: But [when] you fast anoint your - head and wash - your face

verses.original: ὅπως νηστεύων φανῇς μὴ τοῖς ἀνθρώποις ἀλλὰ τῷ σου Πατρί τῷ ἐν τῷ κρυφαίῳ καὶ ὁ σου Πατήρ ὁ βλέπων ἐν τῷ κρυφαίῳ ἀποδώσει σοι
verses.transliteration: hopōs nēsteuōn phanēs mē tois anthrōpois alla tō sou Patri tō en tō kryphaiō kai ho sou Patēr ho blepōn en tō kryphaiō apodōsei soi
verses.literal: so that [your] fasting will not be obvious . . . - to men but only to your Father who [is] vvv vvv unseen And - your Father who sees vvv what is done in secret will reward you

verses.original: Μὴ θησαυρίζετε ὑμῖν θησαυροὺς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ὅπου σὴς καὶ βρῶσις ἀφανίζει καὶ ὅπου κλέπται διορύσσουσιν καὶ κλέπτουσιν
verses.transliteration: Mē thēsaurizete hymin thēsaurous epi tēs gēs hopou sēs kai brōsis aphanizei kai hopou kleptai dioryssousin kai kleptousin
verses.literal: [Do] not store up for yourselves treasures on - earth where moth and rust destroy and where thieves break in and steal

verses.original: δὲ θησαυρίζετε ὑμῖν θησαυροὺς ἐν οὐρανῷ ὅπου σὴς οὔτε βρῶσις οὔτε ἀφανίζει καὶ οὐ ὅπου κλέπται διορύσσουσιν οὐδὲ κλέπτουσιν
verses.transliteration: de thēsaurizete hymin thēsaurous en ouranō hopou sēs oute brōsis oute aphanizei kai ou hopou kleptai dioryssousin oude kleptousin
verses.literal: But store up for yourselves treasures in heaven where moth [and] rust vvv do not destroy and . . . where thieves do not break in . . . [and] steal

verses.original: γάρ ὅπου ὁ σου θησαυρός ἐστιν ἐκεῖ ἡ σου καρδία ἔσται καὶ
verses.transliteration: gar hopou ho sou thēsauros estin ekei hē sou kardia estai kai
verses.literal: For where - your treasure is there - your heart will be also

verses.original: ὁ ὀφθαλμός ἐστιν Ὁ λύχνος τοῦ σώματός οὖν ἐὰν ὁ σου ὀφθαλμός ᾖ ἁπλοῦς τὸ σου ὅλον σῶμά ἔσται φωτεινὸν
verses.transliteration: ho ophthalmos estin Ho lychnos tou sōmatos oun ean ho sou ophthalmos ē haplous to sou holon sōma estai phōteinon
verses.literal: The eye is the lamp of the body - If - your eyes are good - your whole body will be full of light

verses.original: δὲ ἐὰν ὁ σου ὀφθαλμός ᾖ πονηρὸς σου ὅλον τὸ σῶμά ἔσται σκοτεινὸν εἰ οὖν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἐν σοὶ ἐστίν σκότος πόσον τὸ σκότος
verses.transliteration: de ean ho sou ophthalmos ē ponēros sou holon to sōma estai skoteinon ei oun to phōs to en soi estin skotos poson to skotos
verses.literal: But if - your eyes are bad your whole - body will be full of darkness If then the light - within you is darkness how great [is] that darkness

verses.original: Οὐδεὶς δύναται δουλεύειν δυσὶ κυρίοις γὰρ ἢ μισήσει τὸν ἕνα καὶ ἀγαπήσει τὸν ἕτερον ἢ ἀνθέξεται ἑνὸς καὶ καταφρονήσει τοῦ ἑτέρου δύνασθε οὐ δουλεύειν Θεῷ καὶ μαμωνᾷ
verses.transliteration: Oudeis dynatai douleuein dysi kyriois gar ē misēsei ton hena kai agapēsei ton heteron ē anthexetai henos kai kataphronēsei tou heterou dynasthe ou douleuein Theō kai mamōna
verses.literal: No one can serve two masters - Either he will hate the one and love the other or he will be devoted to [the] one and despise the other You cannot . . . serve [both] God and money

verses.original: Διὰ τοῦτο λέγω ὑμῖν μὴ μεριμνᾶτε τῇ ὑμῶν ψυχῇ τί φάγητε ἢ τί πίητε μηδὲ τῷ ὑμῶν σώματι τί ἐνδύσησθε ἐστιν οὐχὶ ἡ ψυχὴ πλεῖόν τῆς τροφῆς καὶ τὸ σῶμα τοῦ ἐνδύματος
verses.transliteration: Dia touto legō hymin mē merimnate tē hymōn psychē ti phagēte ē ti piēte mēde tō hymōn sōmati ti endysēsthe estin ouchi hē psychē pleion tēs trophēs kai to sōma tou endymatos
verses.literal: Therefore . . . I tell you [do] not worry about - your life what you will eat or - drink or - [about] your body what you will wear Is not - life more than food and the body [more] than clothes

verses.original: ἐμβλέψατε εἰς τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ὅτι σπείρουσιν οὐ οὐδὲ θερίζουσιν οὐδὲ συνάγουσιν εἰς ἀποθήκας καὶ ὁ ὑμῶν ὁ οὐράνιος Πατὴρ τρέφει αὐτά ὑμεῖς οὐχ μᾶλλον διαφέρετε αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: emblepsate eis ta peteina tou ouranou hoti speirousin ou oude therizousin oude synagousin eis apothēkas kai ho hymōn ho ouranios Patēr trephei auta hymeis ouch mallon diapherete autōn
verses.literal: Look at the birds of the air - They do not sow . . . [or] reap [or] gather into barns and yet - your - heavenly Father feeds them {Are} you not much more valuable than they

verses.original: δὲ τίς ὑμῶν ἐξ μεριμνῶν δύναται προσθεῖναι ἕνα πῆχυν ἐπὶ τὴν αὐτοῦ ἡλικίαν
verses.transliteration: de tis hymōn ex merimnōn dynatai prostheinai hena pēchyn epi tēn autou hēlikian
verses.literal: - Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to - his life

verses.original: Καὶ τί μεριμνᾶτε περὶ ἐνδύματος καταμάθετε πῶς τὰ κρίνα τοῦ ἀγροῦ αὐξάνουσιν οὐ κοπιῶσιν οὐδὲ νήθουσιν
verses.transliteration: Kai ti merimnate peri endymatos katamathete pōs ta krina tou agrou auxanousin ou kopiōsin oude nēthousin
verses.literal: And why do you worry about clothes Consider how the lilies of the field grow [They do] not labor [or] spin

verses.original: δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐδὲ Σολομὼν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ αὐτοῦ δόξῃ περιεβάλετο ὡς ἓν τούτων
verses.transliteration: de legō hymin hoti oude Solomōn en pasē tē autou doxē periebaleto hōs hen toutōn
verses.literal: Yet I tell you that not even Solomon in all - his glory was adorned like one of these

verses.original: δὲ εἰ οὕτως ὁ Θεὸς ἀμφιέννυσιν τὸν χόρτον τοῦ ἀγροῦ ὄντα σήμερον καὶ αὔριον βαλλόμενον εἰς κλίβανον οὐ πολλῷ μᾶλλον ὑμᾶς ὀλιγόπιστοι
verses.transliteration: de ei houtōs ho Theos amphiennysin ton chorton tou agrou onta sēmeron kai aurion ballomenon eis klibanon ou pollō mallon hymas oligopistoi
verses.literal: - If that is how - God clothes the grass of the field which is [here] today and tomorrow [is] thrown into the furnace [will He] not much more [clothe] you O [you] of little faith

verses.original: οὖν Μὴ μεριμνήσητε λέγοντες Τί φάγωμεν ἤ Τί πίωμεν ἤ Τί περιβαλώμεθα
verses.transliteration: oun Mē merimnēsēte legontes Ti phagōmen ē Ti piōmen ē Ti peribalōmetha
verses.literal: Therefore [do] not worry saying What shall we eat or What shall we drink or What shall we wear

verses.original: γὰρ τὰ ἔθνη ἐπιζητοῦσιν πάντα ταῦτα γὰρ ὁ ὑμῶν ὁ οὐράνιος Πατὴρ οἶδεν ὅτι χρῄζετε ἁπάντων τούτων
verses.transliteration: gar ta ethnē epizētousin panta tauta gar ho hymōn ho ouranios Patēr oiden hoti chrēzete hapantōn toutōn
verses.literal: For the Gentiles strive after all these things [and] - your - heavenly Father knows that you need - them

verses.original: δὲ ζητεῖτε πρῶτον τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τὴν αὐτοῦ δικαιοσύνην καὶ πάντα ταῦτα προστεθήσεται ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: de zēteite prōton tēn basileian tou theou kai tēn autou dikaiosynēn kai panta tauta prostethēsetai hymin
verses.literal: But seek first the kingdom of God and - His righteousness and all these things will be added unto you

verses.original: οὖν Μὴ μεριμνήσητε εἰς τὴν αὔριον ἡ γὰρ αὔριον μεριμνήσει ἑαυτῆς τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἀρκετὸν κακία ἡ αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: oun Mē merimnēsēte eis tēn aurion hē gar aurion merimnēsei heautēs tē hēmera arketon kakia hē autēs
verses.literal: Therefore [do] not worry about - tomorrow - for tomorrow will worry about itself vvv Today [has] enough trouble - of its own
